dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux; uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters typical of GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL
evidence: ASSIGN to symbolic names like RECE01PARA, RECE04PARA
Project code name ORCA, Copyright JMA 2002

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - calculates and aggregates diagnosis category point scores for medical billing claims
purpose.summary: ORCR0030 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It processes indexed RECE02/RECE04/RECE05 files to aggregate and edit point scores by diagnosis category (診療区分別点数集計) for medical insurance claim receipts. The program handles complex Japanese medical billing rules including various insurance combinations, special medical procedures, and co-payment calculations.

notable_features: 35 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter syntax
69 CALL statements indicating heavy use of subprograms
Indexed file I/O with DYNAMIC and SEQUENTIAL access modes
Multiple file aliases via COPY REPLACING (RECE044, RECE055)
Long revision history spanning 2000-2004 with named developers
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
